- 修复了文档乱码问题，全面优化中文支持。
- 完善了Skill描述和触发词，确保功能点清晰易懂。

- Ensured all text and prompts display correctly in Chinese.

- Initial release; no user-facing changes in this version.
- No content modifications in functionality or documentation.

Initial release of bid-management skill.

- Supports full-process bid management: from tender parsing to bid planning and document structure.
- Automatically generates CheckList, bid schedule, directory tree, and, if needed, single-source justification.
- Triggered by keywords such as 投标, 招标, 标书, 投标管理, 投标准备, 单一来源.
- Outputs in Markdown tables, directory trees, or Word/Excel formats as required.
- Ensures complete coverage of tender requirements, highlights high-risk items, and provides actionable suggestions.
